annotation.title_clean: 公共政策網路參與實施要點
annotation.title_en: Implementation Guidelines for Online Public Policy Participation
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 行政院 (Executive Yuan, Taiwan); administered by National Development Council
annotation.summary_en: Taiwan Executive Yuan guidelines (as amended 2018) establishing the online Public Policy Participation Platform: citizen proposals, endorsement (5,000 seconds within 60 days), agency responses, and consultation on policies and draft regulations, with transparency rules. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Nationals and residents may propose policies on the platform after one-time identity verification
Proposals needing 5,000 endorsements within 60 days require agency response
Agencies must respond within two months, extendable by up to two months
Agencies must publicly consult on major policies and draft regulations and publish summary responses
Platform data is open for query, with personal contact data withheld
